title: Vector2
summary: A 2D pair of numbers: X, Y. Used for screen/GUI math (mouse location, AnchorPoint, CanvasPosition) and texture coordinates.

explanation.whatItIs: Vector3's flat sibling for 2D contexts — screens and surfaces.
tips: UDim2 combines Vector2-style scale+offset for GUIs
commonMistakes: Mixing screen pixels with studs — convert deliberately (Camera:ScreenPointToRay)

examples.title: Mouse position
examples.code:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()   -- Vector2 in pixels
print(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
